# Sirach Chapter 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 16 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_016_page_001.jpg

---

**16:1** Do not desire a multitude of useless children, and do not rejoice in ungodly sons.

**16:2** If they multiply, do not rejoice in them unless the fear of the LORD is in them.

**16:3** Do not trust their lives, and do not rely on their numbers; for one is better than a thousand, and to die childless is better than to have ungodly children.

**16:4** For a single man of understanding will populate a city; but a clan of the lawless will be desolated.

**16:5** Many such things my eyes have seen, and my ears have heard things mightier than these.

**16:6** In the assembly of sinners a fire is kindled, and in a disobedient nation wrath is kindled.

**16:7** He was not moved to mercy for the ancient giants who revolted in their strength.

**16:8** He did not spare the neighbors of Lot, whom he abhorred for their arrogance.

**16:9** He did not pity the nation doomed to destruction, those driven out in their sin.

**16:10** And so with the six hundred thousand infantry who were mustered in the hardness of their hearts; even if there had been but one stiff-necked person, it would be a wonder if he went unpunished.

**16:11** For both mercy and wrath are with him; he is mighty to forgive and to pour out wrath.

**16:12** As great as his mercy, so too his correction; he judges a man according to his works.

**16:13** A sinner will not escape with plunder, and the patience of the devout will not be frustrated.

**16:14** He will make room for every act of mercy; each person will receive according to his deeds.

**16:15** He hardened Pharaoh so that he did not acknowledge him, so that the works of God might be known in the world.

**16:16** His mercy is manifest to all creation, and his light and darkness he has allotted to humankind.

**16:17** Do not say, "I will be hidden from the LORD," or "Who will remember me from on high? Among so many people I will not be noticed; for what is my soul among the immense creation?"

**16:18** Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens, the deep and the earth, will tremble at his visitation;

**16:19** together with the mountains and the foundations of the earth — when God looks upon them, they quake with quaking.

**16:20** But of these things no heart will take thought; and who will ponder his ways?

**16:21** Like a storm that no man can see, so too most of his works are hidden.

**16:22** Who will proclaim his acts of righteousness? Or who will await them? For the covenant is far away.

**16:23** A person with little understanding thinks these things over, and a foolish, deluded person imagines foolishness.

**16:24** Listen to me, my child, and learn knowledge, and give your heart to my words.

**16:25** I will pour out instruction by weight, and declare knowledge carefully.

**16:26** When God created his works from the beginning, and as soon as he made them, he assigned their portions.

**16:27** He arranged his works in an eternal order, and their dominions from generation to generation. They do not hunger or grow weary, and they do not cease from their work.

**16:28** None of them jostles another, and they will never disobey his word.

**16:29** After these things, the LORD looked upon the earth, and filled it with his good things.

**16:30** With all kinds of living things he covered its surface, and to it they will return.
